blocks.original_text:
A Shared LSTM Forecast for 3-D UAV Planning with Coupled MPC--DWA in Dynamic Obstacle Fields
Zhenhui Fu*, Beijing University of Chemical Technology, Beijing 100029, China. *Corresponding author: 2025090094@buct.edu.cn.
blocks.translation: 动态障碍场中共享 LSTM 预测的三维无人机耦合 MPC–DWA 规划 作者：Zhenhui Fu*；北京化工大学，中国北京 100029。*通讯作者：2025090094@buct.edu.cn。

blocks.original_text: First, a UAV must avoid moving obstacles in three dimensions even when turns, acceleration and pauses make their motion difficult to predict. Second, the method couples model predictive control (MPC) and the dynamic window approach (DWA) through one causal long short-term memory (LSTM) forecast. MPC uses it to optimize a route; DWA screens reachable actions and bounds MPC's first command. Then, in a frozen 500-scene comparison with a 1-s DWA screen, shared LSTM achieved collision-free goal arrival in 936/1,500 runs (62.4%), versus 836/1,500 (55.7%) when only DWA received LSTM. The paired difference was 6.7 percentage points (95% scene-cluster confidence interval, 4.2--9.2). In a separate 100-scene exploratory evaluation with a 3-s DWA screen, sharing reached 73.7%; its contrast with DWA-only LSTM was inconclusive. Standalone MPC-CV reached 92.0%, the highest rate in that evaluation. Finally, the simulations show a gain from forecast sharing under the frozen 1-s DWA protocol, while standalone MPC-CV led the separate 3-s evaluation.
blocks.translation: 首先，无人机必须在三维空间躲避运动障碍物，即使障碍物转向、加速或暂停也要安全规划。其次，本方法将模型预测控制（MPC）与动态窗口法（DWA）通过同一条因果长短期记忆网络（LSTM）预测相连：MPC 用预测优化路径，DWA 筛选可达动作并约束 MPC 的首个指令。然后，在冻结方案的 500 场景、DWA 滚动时域为 1 s 的对比中，共享 LSTM 有 936/1,500 次无碰撞到达（62.4%），仅向 DWA 输入 LSTM 的方法为 836/1,500 次（55.7%）；配对差为 6.7 个百分点（按场景聚类的 95% 置信区间：4.2–9.2）。在另一个 DWA 时域为 3 s 的 100 场景探索性评估中，共享方法到达率为 73.7%，与仅向 DWA 输入 LSTM 的差异区间包含零；独立 MPC-CV 的到达率最高，为 92.0%。最后，仿真结果显示，共享预测在冻结的 1 s DWA 方案下带来提升，而独立 MPC-CV 在单独的 3 s 评估中到达率最高。

blocks.original_text: UAV, 3D path planning, dynamic obstacles, LSTM, model predictive control, dynamic window approach
blocks.translation: 无人机；三维路径规划；动态障碍物；长短期记忆网络；模型预测控制；动态窗口法。

blocks.original_text: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) must avoid obstacles that move during flight. Turns, acceleration and pauses make their recent positions unreliable guides to what happens next. Model predictive control (MPC) optimizes a short future route; the dynamic window approach (DWA) chooses a feasible action for the next step [1, 2]. Recent UAV planners also use predicted obstacle motion in MPC [3, 4]. We test whether one causal long short-term memory (LSTM) forecast, shared by MPC and DWA, improves the coupled planner relative to one-layer forecast input, constant-velocity (CV) prediction and standalone controllers. We also compare with a project-local latest-position-hold reconstruction of the MPC--DWA baseline, because the source paper does not specify an executable dynamic-obstacle predictor [5]. The shared forecast connects route optimization to DWA's reachable-action screening and local safety gates.
blocks.translation: 无人机（UAV）必须避开飞行过程中移动的障碍物。障碍物转向、加速或暂停，使近期位置难以可靠地指示其后续运动。模型预测控制（MPC）优化一段短期路线，动态窗口法（DWA）选择飞行器下一步能够执行的动作 [1, 2]。近期无人机规划研究也将障碍物运动预测用于 MPC [3, 4]。本文检验将同一条因果长短期记忆网络（LSTM）预测共享给 MPC 和 DWA，能否改善耦合规划，并与仅向一层输入预测、恒定速度（CV）预测及独立控制器进行比较。我们还比较了一个基于 MPC–DWA 基线构建的项目内最新位置保持重构，因为原论文未规定可执行的动态障碍物预测器 [5]。共享预测将路线优化与 DWA 的可达动作筛查及局部安全门限连接起来。

blocks.original_text: We model the UAV as a collision sphere in a bounded 3-D workspace with a start, goal and moving spherical obstacles. Each obstacle has an observed center, radius and time-varying path; future ground-truth positions are hidden from the planner. At each update, it chooses a dynamically feasible action to reach the goal without intersecting an obstacle along the simulated motion. Figure 1 shows the scene geometry; recorded planner paths are compared separately.
blocks.translation: 我们将无人机建模为一个碰撞球体，在有界三维工作空间内从起点飞向目标，并避让球形移动障碍物。每个障碍物具有观测到的中心、半径和随时间变化的路径；规划器无法获知其未来真实位置。每次更新时，规划器选择满足动力学可行性的动作，以便到达目标且在仿真运动过程中不与障碍物相交。图 1 展示场景几何；记录到的规划器路径另行比较。

blocks.original_text: Three-dimensional scene schematic showing the UAV at the start, the goal, spherical obstacles and their prescribed paths.
blocks.translation: 三维问题几何示意：无人机从起点朝目标移动，球形障碍物沿预设路径运动。

blocks.original_text: Problem geometry: the quadrotor is centered at the start and moves toward the goal among spherical obstacles following prescribed paths (arrows). The dashed line marks the direct start-to-goal direction, not a simulated route; planner trajectories appear separately in Figure 4.
blocks.translation: 问题几何：四旋翼无人机以起点为中心位置，朝目标移动；球形障碍物沿预设路径运动（箭头所示）。虚线表示起点到目标的直达方向，并非仿真路线；规划器轨迹另见图 4。

blocks.original_text: With the scene defined, the planner uses one causal obstacle forecast to align route optimization with near-term action screening.
blocks.translation: 场景建模后，规划器使用同一条因果障碍物预测，使路线优化与近期动作筛查相衔接。

blocks.original_text: The following compact relations define the state update, obstacle forecast and quantities used by the planners.
blocks.translation: 下面用几组紧凑公式定义状态更新、障碍物预测及规划器使用的量。

blocks.original_text: Equation (1): UAV state update and predicted signed surface clearance.
blocks.translation: 式（1）：无人机状态更新与预测带符号表面间隙。
blocks.latex:
\begin{aligned}
\mathbf h_t&=[\cos\theta_t\cos\psi_t,\cos\theta_t\sin\psi_t,\sin\theta_t]^{\mathsf T},\\
\mathbf p_{t+1}&=\mathbf p_t+\Delta t\,v_t\mathbf h_t,\\
v_{t+1}&=v_t+\frac{\Delta t}{\tau_v}(v_{c,t}-v_t),\\
\theta_{t+1}&=\theta_t+\Delta t\,\omega_{\theta,t},\quad
\psi_{t+1}=\psi_t+\Delta t\,\omega_{\psi,t},\\
\hat d_{j,k}&=\|\mathbf p_{t+k|t}-\hat{\mathbf o}_{j,t+k|t}\|_2-r_u-r_j.
\end{aligned}

blocks.original_text: Here $t$ is the current step, $k$ a future step, and $j=1,\ldots,M$ indexes the $M$ obstacles. The unit direction $\mathbf h_t$ follows the UAV's pitch $\theta_t$ and yaw $\psi_t$. The update period is $\Delta t=0.1$ s; $\tau_v$ is the speed-response time; $v_c,\omega_\theta,\omega_\psi$ are commanded speed, pitch rate and yaw rate. In the clearance term, $\mathbf p_{t+k|t}$ and $\hat{\mathbf o}_{j,t+k|t}$ are the predicted UAV position and obstacle centre at step $k$. The UAV and obstacle radii are $r_u$ and $r_j$. Positive $\hat d_{j,k}$ means separation, zero contact, and negative overlap.
blocks.translation: 这里，$t$ 表示当前步，$k$ 表示未来步，$j=1,\ldots,M$ 为 $M$ 个障碍物的索引。单位方向 $\mathbf h_t$ 由无人机俯仰角 $\theta_t$ 和偏航角 $\psi_t$ 决定。更新间隔 $\Delta t=0.1$ s；$\tau_v$ 为速度响应时间；$v_c,\omega_\theta,\omega_\psi$ 分别是速度、俯仰角速度和偏航角速度指令。在间隙计算中，$\mathbf p_{t+k|t}$ 与 $\hat{\mathbf o}_{j,t+k|t}$ 分别表示第 $k$ 步预测的无人机位置和障碍物中心。$r_u$ 和 $r_j$ 分别为无人机与障碍物半径。$\hat d_{j,k}$ 为带符号表面间隙：正值表示分离，零表示接触，负值表示重叠。

blocks.source_location: main.tex: CV and causal LSTM forecast introduction
blocks.original_text: At each update, the causal LSTM [6] maps ten obstacle observations to thirty 3-D offsets from the latest observed centre:
blocks.translation: 每次更新时，因果 LSTM [6] 将障碍物连续十次观测映射为相对于最新观测中心的 30 个三维偏移量：

blocks.original_text: Equation (2): CV extrapolation and causal LSTM obstacle-position forecast.
blocks.translation: 式（2）：CV 外推与因果 LSTM 障碍物位置预测。

blocks.original_text: Here $s$ indexes history and $k=1,\ldots,30$ indexes forecast steps. The position $\mathbf o$ and velocity $\mathbf v$ in $\mathbf q$ are observed obstacle inputs, followed by sine and cosine of heading $\chi$; thus $\mathbf q$ has eight features. The trained network $f_\Theta$ uses learned weights $\Theta$ and outputs a 3-D offset for each future step; $[\cdot]_k$ selects offset $k$. Ten observations span 0.9 s and the 30 outputs span 3 s. The forecast is causal and each offset is anchored to the latest observed centre, not cumulatively summed. At startup, the earliest state fills missing history. CV baselines extrapolate from the latest two observed positions (zero initial velocity when only one is available); position hold repeats the latest centre. Training details are in Supplementary Methods.
blocks.translation: 这里，$s$ 表示历史时刻索引，$k=1,\ldots,30$ 表示预测步。$\mathbf q$ 中的 $\mathbf o$ 和 $\mathbf v$ 是观测到的障碍物位置和速度，后两项是障碍物航向角 $\chi$ 的余弦与正弦，因此共有八个输入特征。$f_\Theta$ 是经过训练的网络，$\Theta$ 表示其学习得到的权重；网络为每个未来步输出一个三维偏移量，$[\cdot]_k$ 选取第 $k$ 个偏移。十次观测覆盖 0.9 s，30 个输出覆盖 3 s。预测仅依赖当前及过去信息，每个偏移均锚定在最新观测中心，而非逐步累加。启动时以最早可用状态填充历史。CV 基线根据最近两个观测位置外推（仅有一次观测时初速度置零）；位置保持基线则重复使用最新中心。训练细节见补充方法。

blocks.source_location: main.tex: MPC objective and coupling introduction
blocks.original_text: MPC uses the forecast over its 30-step horizon to minimize goal error, control effort and changes, route deviation, and obstacle-clearance penalties:
blocks.translation: MPC 在 30 步预测时域内使用障碍物预测，并综合最小化目标误差、控制量及其变化、路线偏离和障碍物间隙惩罚：

blocks.original_text: Equation (3): MPC route objective, state recursion, DWA-derived first-input bound, and control-rate limits.
blocks.translation: 式（3）：MPC 路线目标、状态递推、由 DWA 得到的首输入边界及控制变化率限制。
blocks.latex:
\begin{aligned}
\min_{\mathbf u_{1:30}}J_{\rm MPC}={}&
\sum_{k=0}^{29}w_p\|\mathbf p_{t+k|t}-\mathbf g\|_2^2\\
&+w_f\|\mathbf p_{t+30|t}-\mathbf g\|_2^2+w_rJ_r\\
&+\sum_{k=1}^{30}w_u\|\mathbf u_k\|_2^2
+w_{\Delta u}\sum_{k=2}^{30}\|\mathbf u_k-\mathbf u_{k-1}\|_2^2\\
&+\sum_{k=1}^{30}\sum_j
\left(w_o[-\hat d_{j,k}]_+^2+w_s[d_{\rm soft}-\hat d_{j,k}]_+^2\right),\\
\text{s.t. }&\mathbf x_{t+k|t}=f(\mathbf x_{t+k-1|t},\mathbf u_k),\quad
\mathbf u_1\in\mathcal U_t\ \text{if }\mathcal A_t\ne\varnothing.
\end{aligned}

blocks.original_text: Here $\mathbf u_{1:30}$ denotes the sequence of 30 future commands; $\mathbf x=[\mathbf p^{\mathsf T},\theta,\psi,v]^{\mathsf T}$ is the position--pitch--yaw--speed state; $\mathbf u_k=[v_{c,k},\omega_{\theta,k},\omega_{\psi,k}]^{\mathsf T}$ is command $k$, $\mathbf g$ is the goal, and $f$ is the discrete state transition in Eq. (1). $J_r$ sums squared cross-track distances from the direct start-to-goal line. The weights $w_p,w_f,w_r,w_u,w_{\Delta u},w_o,w_s$ penalize stage goal error, terminal error, route deviation, control effort, command changes, overlap and clearance below $d_{\rm soft}=0.35$ m. The positive-part function is $[x]_+=\max(0,x)$. Physical command and rate limits remain active; because native command values are squared without cross-channel normalization, the effort term is heuristic rather than physical energy. Full geometric definitions, weights and limits are in Supplementary Methods S1.1. Clearance penalties are soft and do not certify safety.
blocks.translation: 这里，$\mathbf u_{1:30}$ 表示未来 30 步控制指令组成的序列；$\mathbf x=[\mathbf p^{\mathsf T},\theta,\psi,v]^{\mathsf T}$ 表示位置、俯仰角、偏航角和速度状态；$\mathbf u_k=[v_{c,k},\omega_{\theta,k},\omega_{\psi,k}]^{\mathsf T}$ 是第 $k$ 步控制指令，$\mathbf g$ 是目标点，$f$ 表示式（1）中的离散状态转移函数。$J_r$ 汇总预测路线相对起点—目标直线的平方横向距离。权重 $w_p,w_f,w_r,w_u,w_{\Delta u},w_o,w_s$ 依次惩罚阶段目标误差、终端误差、路线偏差、控制量、控制变化、障碍物重叠，以及小于 $d_{\rm soft}=0.35$ m 的间隙。正部函数为 $[x]_+=\max(0,x)$。物理控制量与变化率限值始终生效；实现中不同单位的控制量直接平方且未作通道归一化，因此控制代价是启发式量，而非物理能量。几何定义、权重和限值见补充方法 S1.1。间隙项是软惩罚，本身不构成安全保证。

blocks.original_text: Trust allocates DWA samples between guided and exploratory actions using safety, goal progress, agreement with the previous MPC guide, and control smoothness:
blocks.translation: 信任评分依据预测安全性、目标推进、与上一轮 MPC 引导路线的一致程度和控制平滑性，在 DWA 引导采样与探索采样之间分配计算资源：

blocks.original_text: Equation (4): trust score, reference agreement, and guided/exploratory sample counts.
blocks.translation: 式（4）：信任评分、参考路线一致度以及引导/探索采样数量。

blocks.original_text: The scores $\tau_{\rm sa},\tau_g,\tau_{\rm ref},\tau_{\rm sm}$ measure safety, goal progress, agreement with the previous MPC guide and control smoothness; their nonnegative weights $\sigma_s,\sigma_g,\sigma_t,\sigma_m$ sum to one. The mismatch $\Delta_p$ is the distance from the current UAV position to the guide's first predicted position, and $\alpha_T=3~\mathrm{m}^{-1}$. The 300-based budget $B$ splits into guided samples $B_g$ and exploratory samples $B_e$; higher trust raises the guided share while reducing the total budget. The weights were selected in a separate 4,320-episode Stage-1 development sweep (six vectors, five integrated arms, 48 scenes and three seeds). The selected vector $[0.15,0.15,0.15,0.55]$ maximized the five-arm equal-weight mean collision-free goal-arrival rate (0.8042) in that development set, not a held-out test. The historical 1-s benchmark retained inherited weights $[0.35,0.30,0.15,0.20]$, untuned on its 500 scenes. Budget settings $\alpha=1$, $\beta=3$ and reference-decay setting $\alpha_T=3~\mathrm{m}^{-1}$ are fixed implementation values; planned Stage-2 calibration was incomplete. Full score definitions and parameters are in Supplementary Methods S1.2.
blocks.translation: 四项评分 $\tau_{\rm sa},\tau_g,\tau_{\rm ref},\tau_{\rm sm}$ 分别衡量安全性、目标推进、与上一轮 MPC 引导路线的一致性及控制平滑度；非负权重 $\sigma_s,\sigma_g,\sigma_t,\sigma_m$ 之和为 1。$\Delta_p$ 是当前无人机位置与引导路线首个预测位置之间的距离，$\alpha_T=3~\mathrm{m}^{-1}$。以 300 为基数的总预算 $B$ 分为引导样本 $B_g$ 和探索样本 $B_e$；信任度越高，引导样本比例越大，但总预算越小。权重由单独的 4,320 次阶段 1 开发实验选出（六组权重、五种集成分支、48 个场景、每场景 3 个种子）。向量 $[0.15,0.15,0.15,0.55]$ 在该开发集上使五分支等权平均无碰撞到达率最高（0.8042），但这不是留出测试。历史 1 s 基准保留继承权重 $[0.35,0.30,0.15,0.20]$，未在其 500 个场景上调参。预算参数 $\alpha=1$、$\beta=3$ 和参考衰减参数 $\alpha_T=3~\mathrm{m}^{-1}$ 均为固定实现设置；计划中的阶段 2 校准尚未完成。完整评分定义和参数见补充方法 S1.2。

blocks.original_text: DWA rejects unsafe rollouts, scores the survivors, and uses their control range to bound MPC's first input:
blocks.translation: DWA 首先剔除不安全的滚动轨迹，再对保留动作评分，并用其控制范围约束 MPC 的首个输入：

blocks.original_text: Equation (5): DWA safe set, action score, and componentwise candidate envelope.
blocks.translation: 式（5）：DWA 安全集、动作评分及候选动作分量包络。
blocks.latex:
\begin{aligned}
\mathcal A_t&=\{b\in\mathcal B_t:d_{\min}^{(b)}>0.25~\mathrm m,\ \mathcal C_b=1,\\
&\hspace{1em}(v_{\rm end}^{(b)})^2\leq2a_{\max}d_{\min}^{(b)}\},\quad
b^*=\arg\max_{b\in\mathcal A_t}S_b,\\
u_{i,t}^{-}&=\max\!\left(u_i^{\min},\min_{b\in\mathcal A_t}u_i^{(b)}-\delta\right),\\
u_{i,t}^{+}&=\min\!\left(u_i^{\max},\max_{b\in\mathcal A_t}u_i^{(b)}+\delta\right),\\
\mathcal U_t&=\prod_{i=1}^{3}[u_{i,t}^{-},u_{i,t}^{+}],\quad \delta=0.1.
\end{aligned}

blocks.original_text: Here $\mathcal B_t$ is the sampled set, and $d_{\min}^{(b)}$ is candidate $b$'s minimum clearance over the active DWA screen and all obstacles. The frozen benchmark screens the first 10 forecast states (1 s); the separate exploratory evaluation screens all 30 (3 s). MPC uses a 30-step (3-s) horizon in both. The indicator $\mathcal C_b=1$ means the rollout remains inside the flight corridor. The terminal speed is $v_{\rm end}^{(b)}$ and available deceleration is $a_{\max}=1.0$ m s$^{-2}$. $S_b$ ranks MPC-endpoint agreement, heading, speed, obstacle clearance and vertical profile. For a nonempty safe set $\mathcal A_t$, its per-coordinate extrema, expanded by $\delta=0.1$ in each control coordinate and clipped to its physical limits $u_i^{\min},u_i^{\max}$, form $\mathcal U_t$; this numerical margin is an implementation heuristic because the controls have different units. The DWA action is executed unless optional lateral recentering is triggered; the adjusted rollout is re-screened, and failure reverts to the original screened action. The envelope constrains only MPC's first command and is not a safety certificate. If the normal safe set is empty, emergency actions are screened; if none passes, the simulator stops. Full scores and fallback logic are in Supplementary Methods S1.2--S1.4.
blocks.translation: 这里，$\mathcal B_t$ 是采样动作集合；$d_{\min}^{(b)}$ 是候选动作 $b$ 在当前 DWA 筛查时域和全部障碍物中的最小间隙。冻结基准筛查前 10 个预测状态（1 s），另一项探索性评估筛查全部 30 个状态（3 s）；两者的 MPC 时域均为 30 步（3 s）。$\mathcal C_b=1$ 表示轨迹未离开飞行走廊。$v_{\rm end}^{(b)}$ 为末端速度，可用减速度 $a_{\max}=1.0$ m s$^{-2}$。评分 $S_b$ 综合 MPC 终点一致性、航向、速度、障碍物间隙和垂直剖面。若安全集 $\mathcal A_t$ 非空，则各控制分量在安全候选中的最小值和最大值经 $\delta=0.1$ 扩展，并裁剪到对应分量的物理限值 $u_i^{\min},u_i^{\max}$，形成 $\mathcal U_t$；由于三个控制分量单位不同，这个数值裕度是实现中的启发式量。若触发可选横向重居中，调整后的轨迹必须重新筛查；未通过时恢复原先筛查通过的动作。该范围只约束 MPC 首个控制指令，不是安全证书。若普通安全集为空，则筛查应急动作；若均不通过，仿真停止。完整评分与回退流程见补充方法 S1.2–S1.4。

blocks.source_location: main.tex: How the shared forecast is used
blocks.original_text: Every 0.1 s, the causal LSTM produces one time-aligned 3-s obstacle forecast for both planners. MPC uses all 30 positions in its route cost; DWA screens the first 10 in the frozen benchmark and all 30 in the separate exploratory evaluation. The passing DWA controls constrain MPC's first command on re-solve, while the screened DWA action is executed. Sharing the forecast is intended to keep route optimization and local safety screening consistent; the frozen comparison tests its incremental effect when DWA already receives LSTM input. In the DWA-only arm, MPC instead uses latest-position hold in the historical benchmark and its configured CV input in the 3-s ablation. Figure 2 summarizes the cycle; Supplementary Methods S1.4 gives the full fallback logic.
blocks.translation: 每 0.1 s，因果 LSTM 为两个规划器生成同一条按时间对齐的 3 s 障碍物预测。MPC 在路径代价中使用全部 30 个位置；冻结基准中的 DWA 筛查前 10 个位置，另一项探索性评估中的 DWA 则筛查全部 30 个位置。通过筛查的 DWA 控制范围在 MPC 重求解时约束其首个指令，同时执行筛查通过的 DWA 动作。共享预测旨在让路线优化和局部安全筛查基于一致的障碍物未来位置；冻结对比检验的是在 DWA 已获得 LSTM 输入时，再将该预测提供给 MPC 的增量效果。在 DWA-only 组中，历史基准的 MPC 使用最新位置保持，3 s 单层消融中的 MPC 则使用其配置的 CV 输入。图 2 概括该循环，完整回退流程见补充方法 S1.4。

blocks.original_text: Stepwise modules in one shared-forecast update. The same causal LSTM forecast feeds the MPC route optimizer and DWA action selector. Passing DWA controls bound MPC's first input; a triggered recentering is used only after re-screening. The screened DWA or emergency action is executed, with fail-closed stop if no emergency action passes.
blocks.translation: 共享预测规划器单次更新的分步骤模块图。同一条因果 LSTM 预测同时输入 MPC 路线优化模块和 DWA 动作筛选模块。通过筛选的 DWA 控制范围约束 MPC 的首个指令；触发横向重居中后，调整动作只有通过复筛才会采用。最终执行筛查通过的 DWA 或应急动作；若没有应急动作通过，则安全停止。

blocks.source_location: main.tex: Simulation and Results, opening paragraph
blocks.original_text: Under the frozen 1-s DWA/3-s MPC protocol with inherited weights, 500 scenes and three matched seeds compared shared LSTM with DWA-only LSTM. DWA received LSTM forecasts in both arms; only the shared arm also supplied them to MPC. Safe arrival was 936/1,500 (62.4%) versus 836/1,500 (55.7%), a paired gain of 6.7 percentage points (95% scene-cluster CI, 4.2--9.2). These 3,000 runs are part of the 7,500-run benchmark, not an extra sample. In the same protocol, standalone DWA+LSTM and MPC+LSTM reached 82.4% and 95.2%, respectively, while the latest-position-hold reconstruction reached 2.2%. Forecast sharing improved on DWA-only input but did not outperform the independent controllers overall.
blocks.translation: 在冻结的 1 s DWA/3 s MPC 方案及继承权重下，我们用 500 个场景、每场景三个匹配种子比较共享 LSTM 与仅 DWA 使用 LSTM 的集成方法。两组 DWA 都接收 LSTM 预测；只有共享组还将预测输入 MPC。共享组无碰撞到达 936/1,500 次（62.4%），仅 DWA 使用 LSTM 组为 836/1,500 次（55.7%），配对差为 6.7 个百分点（按场景聚类的 95% CI：4.2–9.2）。这 3,000 次运行已包含在五控制器基准的 7,500 次记录中，并非新增样本。同一方案下，独立 DWA+LSTM 和独立 MPC+LSTM 到达率分别为 82.4% 和 95.2%，最新位置保持重构为 2.2%。因此，共享预测优于仅向 DWA 输入预测，但总体上不优于独立控制器。

blocks.original_text: The separate exploratory evaluation comprised 2,100 episodes: seven arms, 100 distinct scenes and three matched seeds per scene. It used 0.1-s updates, 3-s MPC/DWA horizons and a 650-step limit. The arms were standalone DWA-CV and MPC-CV, coupled MPC--DWA-CV, LSTM to MPC only, LSTM to DWA only, shared LSTM and latest-position hold. Arrival required goal tolerance without swept-path contact; seeds were averaged within scene, and 20,000 scene-cluster bootstrap resamples formed simultaneous max-|t| intervals for six shared-versus-comparator contrasts. Shared LSTM reached in 221/300 runs (73.7%), compared with 276/300 (92.0%) for standalone MPC-CV, the highest rate; MPC-CV also had 15 swept-contact runs. Its difference from DWA-only LSTM was inconclusive; it exceeded position hold by 16.3 points (95% CI, 5.1--27.6) but was 18.3 points below MPC-CV (95% CI, -29.6 to -7.0). This evaluation also does not establish an overall best controller.
blocks.translation: 另一个探索性评估共 2,100 次运行：七种方法、100 个独立场景，每场景三个匹配种子。仿真每 0.1 s 更新，MPC 与 DWA 时域均为 3 s，最多运行 650 步。七种方法为独立 DWA-CV、独立 MPC-CV、耦合 MPC–DWA-CV、仅 MPC 使用 LSTM、仅 DWA 使用 LSTM、共享 LSTM 和最新位置保持。安全到达要求进入目标容差且扫掠路径无接触；先在场景内平均种子结果，再通过 20,000 次场景聚类 bootstrap 为六项共享方法对比构造同时 max-|t| 区间。共享 LSTM 到达 221/300 次（73.7%）；独立 MPC-CV 为 276/300 次（92.0%），是该评估中的最高率，此外还有 15 次扫掠接触。共享方法与仅 DWA 使用 LSTM 的差异尚不确定；它比位置保持高 16.3 个百分点（95% CI：5.1–27.6），但比 MPC-CV 低 18.3 个百分点（95% CI：−29.6 至 −7.0）。该评估不能据此确定总体最优方法。

blocks.original_text: Collision-free goal-arrival rates in two separate protocols. (a) Frozen five-controller benchmark: 500 scenes, three matched seeds, $n=1{,}500$ runs per controller and a 1-s DWA screen. (b) Exploratory seven-controller evaluation: 100 distinct scenes, three matched seeds, $n=300$ runs per controller and a 3-s screen. Bars show observed point estimates; paired scene-cluster intervals are reported in the text and Supplementary Methods. Swept-contact counts follow the displayed method order: 624, 2, 0, 0, 36 in (a), and 0, 15, 0, 0, 0, 0, 50 in (b). The highest-rate method differs by protocol; the panels are not pooled.
blocks.translation: 两套独立方案中的无碰撞到达率。(a) 冻结的五控制器基准：500 个场景、每场景三个匹配种子、每种控制器 $n=1{,}500$ 次运行，DWA 筛查时域为 1 s。(b) 探索性七方法评估：100 个不同场景、每场景三个匹配种子、每种控制器 $n=300$ 次运行，DWA 时域为 3 s。柱形表示观察到的点估计；配对场景聚类区间见正文和补充方法。扫掠接触数按图中方法顺序分别为 (a) 624、2、0、0、36 次，(b) 0、15、0、0、0、0、50 次。两套方案中观察到的最高到达率分别属于独立 MPC+LSTM 和独立 MPC-CV；两面板不合并排序。

blocks.original_text: A matched route from the separate seven-method evaluation (scene 72, sampling seed 2) is shown in Figure 4. Shared LSTM and DWA-CV arrived safely in this example; the other five did not achieve collision-free goal arrival. This single case illustrates route geometry, not the aggregate ranking.
blocks.translation: 图 4 展示另一项七方法评估中场景 72、采样种子 2 的匹配路线。在这一示例中，共享 LSTM 与 DWA-CV 安全到达，其他五种方法均未实现无碰撞到达。该单例仅用于展示路线形态，不能代替总体排序或统计结果。

blocks.original_text: Recorded simulated 3-D paths from the five-controller, 500-scene benchmark, scene 404, seed 2; each plotted route ends at its logged terminal state.
blocks.translation: 五控制器 500 场景基准中场景 404、种子 2 的仿真三维路径；每条绘制轨迹均截止于日志记录的终止状态。

blocks.original_text: Seven recorded paths in one matched case (scene 72, seed 2). Shared LSTM and DWA-CV arrived without swept contact; MPC-CV reached goal tolerance but had swept contact; the other methods stopped or contacted earlier. Lines join saved states without interpolation, smoothing or extension, and end at recorded terminal points. Markers show outcome, not contact location. This example is descriptive; aggregate rates appear in Figure 3b.
blocks.translation: 场景 72、种子 2 中一个匹配示例的七条记录轨迹。共享 LSTM 与 DWA-CV 无扫掠接触地到达目标；MPC-CV 到达目标容差范围但发生扫掠接触；其余方法提前停止或发生接触。轨迹仅连接已保存状态，不作插值、平滑或延伸，并止于记录的终止点。标记表示结果状态，不表示接触位置。该示例仅用于说明路径形态；总体到达率见图 3b。

blocks.original_text: Outcome summary for the exploratory simulation (300 episodes per arm). Safe arrival requires reaching the goal without swept-path contact; complete paired intervals are reported in the Supplementary Methods.
blocks.translation: 探索性仿真结果汇总，每种方法 300 次运行。安全到达要求进入目标容差且扫掠路径无接触；完整配对区间见补充方法。

blocks.original_text: The historical five-controller study used 500 scenes with three matched seeds per scene (1,500 episodes per arm), a 1-s DWA rollout and a 30-step MPC horizon. Shared LSTM reached the goal without contact in 936/1,500 episodes (62.4%), compared with 33/1,500 (2.2%) for latest-position hold and 836/1,500 (55.7%) for LSTM-to-DWA-only integration. The paired differences were +60.2 percentage points (95% scene-cluster CI, +56.2 to +64.2) and +6.7 points (+4.2 to +9.2), respectively. Standalone DWA+LSTM and MPC+LSTM reached in 1,236/1,500 (82.4%) and 1,428/1,500 (95.2%). Shared integration was lower than these arms by 20.0 points (95% CI, -24.8 to -15.1) and 32.8 points (-37.1 to -28.5). This historical 1-s study is separate from the current seven-method, 3-s-horizon evaluation.
blocks.translation: 历史五控制器研究在 500 个场景、每场景三个匹配种子上进行测试（每种方法 1,500 次），DWA 滚动时域为 1 s，MPC 时域为 30 步。共享 LSTM 在 1,500 次运行中有 936 次无接触到达目标（62.4%）；最新位置保持组为 33/1,500 次（2.2%），仅向 DWA 输入 LSTM 的集成组为 836/1,500 次（55.7%）。相应配对差异为 +60.2 个百分点（按场景聚类的 95% CI：+56.2 至 +64.2）和 +6.7 个百分点（+4.2 至 +9.2）。独立 DWA+LSTM 和 MPC+LSTM 分别有 1,236/1,500 次（82.4%）和 1,428/1,500 次（95.2%）到达。共享集成方法分别低 20.0 个百分点（95% CI：−24.8 至 −15.1）和 32.8 个百分点（−37.1 至 −28.5）。这项历史 1 s 研究与当前七方法、3 s 时域评估相互独立。

blocks.original_text: Retained results from the historical five-controller study (500 scenes, three matched seeds and 1,500 runs per method; 1-s DWA screening). The latest-position-hold MPC--DWA is a project-local reconstruction, not an exact reproduction.
blocks.translation: 保留的历史五控制器研究结果（500 个场景、每场景三个匹配种子，每种方法 1,500 次；DWA 筛查时域为 1 s）。最新位置保持 MPC–DWA 是项目内重构，并非精确复现。

blocks.original_text: The two protocols indicate a protocol-specific benefit: forecast sharing raised safe arrival in the frozen 1-s screen comparison, but not in the 3-s exploratory comparison; standalone MPC-CV had the highest rate there. Because scene banks, trust weights and horizons also differed, these studies do not isolate the source of that difference. LSTM uses simulator-recorded obstacle velocity and heading, whereas CV estimates velocity from positions, so the contrast concerns configured input pipelines as well as predictors. Prescribed tracks, point forecasts and no flight tests limit generalization.
blocks.translation: 两套方案显示出协议特定的结果：在冻结的 1 s DWA 筛查对比中，共享预测提高了安全到达率；在 3 s 探索性对比中未显示这一优势，而独立 MPC-CV 的到达率最高。由于两套方案的场景库、信任权重和时域也不同，当前证据无法定位造成差异的具体因素。LSTM 使用模拟器记录的障碍物速度和航向，CV 则根据位置估计速度，因此比较涉及具体输入流程，而非只比较预测器。预设轨迹、点预测和未进行实机飞行限制了泛化结论。

blocks.original_text: In simulation, shared LSTM increased collision-free arrival by 6.7 percentage points over DWA-only input in the frozen 500-scene, 1-s DWA comparison. In the separate 3-s evaluation, standalone MPC-CV had the highest rate, and the shared-versus-DWA-only contrast was inconclusive.
blocks.translation: 在仿真中，冻结的 500 场景、1 s DWA 对比显示，共享 LSTM 相较仅向 DWA 输入预测，无碰撞到达率提高了 6.7 个百分点。在单独的 3 s 评估中，独立 MPC-CV 的到达率最高；共享方法与仅 DWA 使用 LSTM 的差异尚不确定。

blocks.original_text: Smoothness uses consecutive MPC control increments $\Delta\mathbf u_k=\mathbf u_k-\mathbf u_{k-1}$. The score is $\tau_{\rm sm}=\operatorname{clip}_{[0,1]}\!\left[1-\frac{1}{3(N-1)}\sum_{i=1}^{3}\sum_{k=2}^{N}\frac{|\Delta u_{k,i}|}{a_{u,i}\Delta t}\right]$. Here $i$ indexes desired speed, pitch rate and yaw rate; $N=30$, $\Delta t=0.1$ s, and $\mathbf a_u=[1~\mathrm{m\,s^{-2}},\ 0.5~\mathrm{rad\,s^{-2}},\ 0.5~\mathrm{rad\,s^{-2}}]^{\mathsf T}$. At startup, the initial MPC solution initializes the aligned reference and control sequence; thereafter, the preceding solution is shifted before the trust scores are computed. Guided controls are sampled within $r_{\rm Guide}=0.35$ per control component of the clipped MPC command, then clipped to the dynamic window. The logistic map is $q=[1+\exp(-8(\tau-0.5))]^{-1}$. The half-width 0.35, slope 8, midpoint 0.5 and additive vertical-score coefficient $w_z=0.25$ are fixed implementation heuristics, held constant in every integrated arm that uses them and not selected using held-out outcomes. The half-width uses native control units ($\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}$ for speed and $\mathrm{rad\,s^{-1}}$ for pitch and yaw rates); slope and midpoint are dimensionless. The $w_z$ term is added after the four normalized DWA weights and is not renormalized with them.
blocks.translation: 平滑度分量使用相邻 MPC 控制量的增量 $\Delta\mathbf u_k=\mathbf u_k-\mathbf u_{k-1}$。其评分定义为 $\tau_{\rm sm}=\operatorname{clip}_{[0,1]}\!\left[1-\frac{1}{3(N-1)}\sum_{i=1}^{3}\sum_{k=2}^{N}\frac{|\Delta u_{k,i}|}{a_{u,i}\Delta t}\right]$。其中，$i$ 依次表示期望速度、俯仰角速度和偏航角速度；$N=30$，$\Delta t=0.1$ s，且 $\mathbf a_u=[1~\mathrm{m\,s^{-2}},\ 0.5~\mathrm{rad\,s^{-2}},\ 0.5~\mathrm{rad\,s^{-2}}]^{\mathsf T}$。启动时，以初始 MPC 解初始化对齐后的参考路线与控制序列；此后在计算信任评分前，对上一周期解进行时移。引导控制在裁剪后的 MPC 指令周围按每个控制分量的 $r_{\rm Guide}=0.35$ 半宽采样，随后裁剪到动态窗口内。逻辑映射为 $q=[1+\exp(-8(\tau-0.5))]^{-1}$。半宽 0.35、斜率 8、中点 0.5 和附加垂直评分系数 $w_z=0.25$ 均为固定实现启发式参数；所有使用这些参数的集成分支均保持不变，且未依据留出结果选择。半宽采用各控制量的原生单位（速度为 $\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}$，俯仰和偏航角速度为 $\mathrm{rad\,s^{-1}}$）；斜率和中点无量纲。$w_z$ 项在四个归一化 DWA 权重之后加入，且不与它们一起重新归一化。

blocks.original_text: The Stage-1 trust-weight calibration evaluated six candidate vectors across five trust-using integrated MPC--DWA branches, 48 development scenes and three matched seeds ($6\times5\times48\times3=4{,}320$ simulation episodes). The selected vector $[0.15,0.15,0.15,0.55]$ had an equal-arm macro-average collision-free arrival rate of 0.8042. Development rates were 0.8958 for shared LSTM, 0.7431 for CV-coupled MPC--DWA, 0.8194 for LSTM-to-MPC-only, 0.8958 for LSTM-to-DWA-only and 0.6667 for latest-position hold. These are selection-set descriptions, not held-out comparisons. The earlier 864-episode six-setting comparison used a different protocol and was not reused; a separate recovery audit validated all 4,320 Stage-1 episode records without creating new simulations.
blocks.translation: 阶段 1 信任权重校准在五种使用信任评分的集成 MPC--DWA 分支、48 个开发场景和每场景 3 个匹配种子上评估六个候选向量（$6\times5\times48\times3=4{,}320$ 次仿真）。选出的向量为 $[0.15,0.15,0.15,0.55]$，其五分支等权宏平均无碰撞到达率为 0.8042。开发率分别为：共享 LSTM 0.8958、CV 耦合 MPC--DWA 0.7431、仅 MPC 使用 LSTM 0.8194、仅 DWA 使用 LSTM 0.8958、最新位置保持 0.6667。这些是用于选参的开发集描述值，不是留出对比结果。此前 864 次六设置实验采用不同协议，未用于本次选择；单独的恢复审计对全部 4,320 条记录进行了校验，没有新增仿真。

blocks.original_text: Supplementary Figure S3, historical four-panel 3-D route illustration from scene 2 and DWA sampling seed 1: (a) CV; (b) Kalman; (c) DWA-only LSTM; (d) shared LSTM. CV stops at its recorded endpoint; the other three reach the goal, with no swept collision.
blocks.translation: 补充图 S3，取自场景 2、DWA 采样种子 1 的历史四面板三维路径示例：(a) CV；(b) Kalman；(c) 仅 DWA 使用 LSTM；(d) 共享 LSTM。CV 截止于记录终点，其余三种方法到达目标；四条路线均无扫掠碰撞。

blocks.original_text: Historical four-method 3-D route example from scene 2 and DWA sampling seed 1. Panels (a)--(d) show CV, Kalman, DWA-only LSTM and shared LSTM under the same prescribed obstacle tracks. The green triangle marks the start, the red star the goal, and the open circle CV's recorded early-stop endpoint. In this example, CV stopped before the goal; the other three methods reached the goal, and all four routes were collision-free under the swept-path test. Each route contains only its saved states through the recorded terminal point; none is extended or interpolated. Obstacle tracks show scene context and are not time-aligned with route durations. This single historical example illustrates route geometry, not aggregate performance, and is reported separately from the historical five-controller benchmark and current seven-method evaluation.
blocks.translation: 历史四方法三维路径示例，取自场景 2、DWA 采样种子 1。(a)–(d) 分别为 CV、Kalman、仅 DWA 使用 LSTM 和共享 LSTM，使用相同的预设障碍物轨迹。绿色三角表示起点，红色星形表示目标点，空心圆表示 CV 记录的提前停止位置。在该例中，CV 未到达目标；其余三种方法到达目标，且四条轨迹均未发生扫掠碰撞。每条路线仅包含已记录状态，并截止于实际终止点，不外延或插值。障碍物轨迹仅作为场景背景，未与各方法的飞行时长进行时间对齐。该单个历史示例展示路径形状，不代表总体性能；其结果与历史五控制器基准及当前七方法评估分开报告。

blocks.original_text: Historical five-controller route example from scene 404, seed 2; all paths end at logged terminal states.
blocks.translation: 场景 404、种子 2 的历史五控制器路径示例；所有路径均截止于日志终止状态。

blocks.original_text: Historical five-controller 3-D routes from scene 404, seed 2 in the 1-s DWA-screening study. The recorded paths end at their logged terminal states: latest-position-hold MPC--DWA (collision, step 224); standalone DWA + LSTM (stopped, step 20); standalone MPC + LSTM (collision, step 262); integrated MPC--DWA with LSTM to DWA only (stopped, step 220); and integrated MPC--DWA with shared LSTM (collision-free arrival, step 253). Only the shared controller arrived in this illustrative case; aggregate historical outcomes are in Table T002 and Supplementary Methods S4.3. Dashed lines show saved obstacle tracks through step 262. Circles mark arrivals, squares mark non-collision stops, and X marks a run with swept contact, not necessarily at the terminal marker.
blocks.translation: 1 s DWA 筛查历史研究中，场景 404、种子 2 的五条控制器三维路径。所有记录路径均截止于日志记录的终止状态：最新位置保持 MPC–DWA（第 224 步碰撞）；独立 DWA+LSTM（第 20 步停止）；独立 MPC+LSTM（第 262 步碰撞）；仅向 DWA 输入 LSTM 的集成 MPC–DWA（第 220 步停止）；以及共享 LSTM 的集成 MPC–DWA（第 253 步无碰撞到达）。在这个示例中只有共享控制器到达目标；历史总体结果见表 T002 和补充方法 S4.3。虚线表示保存至第 262 步的障碍物轨迹。圆形表示到达，方形表示无碰撞停止，X 表示运行中发生过扫掠接触，接触位置不一定在终点标记处。

blocks.original_text: Supplementary Figure S5: seven-method scene 72, seed 2 route illustration; all six comparator paths span at least 5 s.
blocks.translation: 补充图 S5：七方法场景 72、种子 2 的路径示例；六条比较方法轨迹均至少记录 5 s。

blocks.original_text: Seven-method simulated trajectories from scene 72, seed 2. (a) 3-D perspective; (b) XY plan; (c) XZ elevation; (d) YZ elevation. All six comparator paths span at least 5 s. Shared LSTM and standalone DWA achieved collision-free goal arrival; standalone MPC reached goal tolerance after swept contact; position-hold MPC--DWA collided before arrival; the other three coupled variants stopped without contact. Each route contains only saved positions through its logged terminal state.
